limits: Same isolated solo camp/forest experience, no new region or full cooperative 3D migration.
Original Blender geometry exports only; no offline render, new external artwork/audio or per-effect dynamic lights/bloom.
Damage numbers use confirmed HP loss; displayed integer rounding is distinct from internal float damage. No critical hits invented.
Camera obstacles are conservative canopy/trunk/rock proxies; other angles require human playtest, no absolute occlusion guarantee.
Visual roll recovery lasts about 0.5 seconds; original dash displacement and invulnerability windows remain, attacks/powers/jump wait for the visual finish.
Performance figures are warmed stationary samples on Intel UHD, not sustained combat or a physical iPhone/FPS guarantee.
Campaign saves, finite kills, research requirements and boss gates preserved; named test fixtures are isolated browser profiles only.
Text canonicalizes CRLF/LF; index.html also ignores blank lines as documented in 0.1.191; JS/CSS/binary model hashes remain exact.
Await user playtest before the next stage.
